TC-06/S05.title: Scan in both contexts: every scanned patient is Follow-up, even 'NEW ADMIT' / 'Consult' rows
TC-06/S05.detail: 12/12 judged cells passed (newspec-c/vis-tc06-s05-s17-scan-status.spec.ts, desktop Chromium, fresh account). ai/vision:scanCensusSheet was answered in the browser with exact rows (no model, the image never reached the server); the status words ride in fields of their own (status: 'NEW ADMIT' / 'Consult' / 'New admit' plus encType 'new' / 'consult'), which no model output schema has, so the test proves the app never takes a status from scanned rows. Hospital: QA Scan Alvarez, Bennett ('NEW ADMIT') and Chen ('Consult') were added with 'Follow-up' on their cards, encType follow-up on the server, and 'Follow-up' selected in Bennett's and Chen's chart header (Admission status select). Nursing Home: QA Scan Dorsey and Ellis ('New admit') were added to Today's Visits with 'Follow-up', show on All Residents with 'In Today ✓' and 'Follow-up', are follow-up and in today's session on the server, and Ellis's chart shows Follow-up. Neither list showed New Admission or Consult on any card. Patients deleted afterwards. Caveat: real OCR is not exercised (dev reads are blocked by B01).
